audit_scope: ProcessBf16FullRowOutputPipelined xBuf_/residualBuf_ staging liveness and MTE2/Vector/MTE3 ownership
dispatch: For BF16, rowWidth == kCacheElems (8192) is non-wide because Init selects widePath_ only when rowWidth > kCacheElems. Multi-row blocks dispatch directly to ProcessBf16FullRowOutputPipelined and return; no prior tile loads or stores execute in Process.

staging_buffers.xBuf: 4096 BF16 elements; reused at offset 0 for gamma tile 1 and later input tiles.
staging_buffers.residualBuf: 4096 BF16 elements; reused at offset 0 for bias tile 1 and later residual tiles.
staging_buffers.gammaBuf_biasBuf: Each holds one 4096-element BF16 tile; after parameter promotion, these are the alternating output staging tiles.
staging_buffers.gammaFp32Buf_biasFp32Buf: Each holds the complete 8192-element FP32 parameter row.

liveness_and_sync: At function entry, xBuf_/residualBuf_ have no live data: Process dispatches directly to this function, and Init only allocates buffers.
The first gamma/bias MTE2 loads target gammaBuf_/biasBuf_; SyncMTE2ToV waits for them before the first parameter conversion.

The second gamma/bias MTE2 loads target xBuf_/residualBuf_ while the first tile is converted into distinct gammaFp32Buf_/biasFp32Buf_ ranges. A second SyncMTE2ToV waits for those loads before their Vector conversion.
PipeBarrier<PIPE_V> and SyncVToMTE2 complete Vector reads of the second staging tiles before the row loop can overwrite xBuf_/residualBuf_ with input data.

Each input tile is consumed only after SyncMTE2ToV; SyncVToMTE2 follows its Vector processing before the same staging slots can be refilled. The next-row prefetch occurs after the last tile release and is consumed at the next row's SyncMTE2ToV.
The MTE3 stores read only gammaBuf_/biasBuf_ output tiles. Per-slot MTE3_V waits guard their reuse, and final waits drain both output slots; MTE3 has no source read from xBuf_/residualBuf_.
assessment: No conflicting live data or missing source-level MTE2/Vector/MTE3 ownership edge was found in R062's second-parameter-tile staging path.
verification_limit: Static source-order audit only; no runtime correctness is claimed. No Build was rerun because source did not change. Correctness/Local runners are absent and no NPU command was run.
